description: Durable Object Storage Optimization - Migrate UserDO to SQL, fix VotingDO unbounded growth, add input validation

userStories.title: Create user/db directory with Drizzle schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database schema structure for the new UserDO.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/api/src/dos/user/db/schema.ts with all tables: tags, taggedNfts, starred, nftOrder, nftSizes, nftLayout, preferences, wallets, meta
Each table has proper primary keys and indexes as specified in PRD
Create apps/api/src/dos/user/db/types.ts with inferred types for all tables
Create apps/api/src/dos/user/db/drizzle.config.ts following nft-cache pattern
Create apps/api/src/dos/user/db/index.ts exporting schema and types
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Generate user migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the SQL migration for the user schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Run drizzle-kit generate for user schema
Migration file created at apps/api/src/dos/user/db/migrations/0000_initial.sql
Create migrations.js and migrations.d.ts following nft-cache pattern
Migration creates all 9 tables with correct columns and indexes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create UserDO with tags and tagged endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the UserDO class with Drizzle and tags/tagged functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/api/src/dos/user/index.ts
UserDO class extends DurableObject with Drizzle setup in constructor
Run migration in blockConcurrencyWhile following existing patterns
Implement getTags, addTag, updateTag, deleteTag methods using Drizzle
Implement getTaggedNfts, getAllTaggedNfts, addNftsToTag, removeNftsFromTag methods
Implement HTTP handlers for /tags and /tagged/* routes
Same API signatures as existing user.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add starred and custom display endpoints to UserDO
userStories.description: As a developer, I need starred, order, sizes, and layout functionality in UserDO.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement getStarred, addToStarred, removeFromStarred methods using starred table
Implement getOrder, setOrder methods using nftOrder table
Implement getSizes, setSizes methods using nftSizes table
Implement getLayout, setLayout methods using nftLayout table
Implement HTTP handlers for /starred, /order/*, /sizes/*, /layout/* routes
Same API signatures as existing user.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add preferences, wallets, and meta endpoints to UserDO
userStories.description: As a developer, I need remaining UserDO functionality and cleanup of old file.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement getPreferences, setPreferences methods using preferences table
Implement getWallets, addWallet, removeWallet methods using wallets table
Implement getDandies, setDandies methods using meta table (JSON value)
Implement getUsername, setUsername, clearUsername methods using meta table
Implement getShowcase, setShowcase methods using meta table (JSON value)
Implement HTTP handlers for /preferences, /wallets, /dandies, /username, /showcase routes
Delete apps/api/src/dos/user.ts (old file)
Same API signatures as existing user.ts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add input validation to UserDO
userStories.description: As a developer, I need input validation to prevent data pollution and abuse.
acceptanceCriteria: Add LIMITS constant with MAX_TAGS=100, MAX_TAG_NAME=50, MAX_CONTEXT=100, MAX_STARRED=5000, MAX_TAGGED_PER_TAG=5000, MAX_WALLETS=20
Add CONTEXT_REGEX for validating context strings
Validate tag name and color length in addTag/updateTag
Validate context format in all context-based operations
Enforce limits: return 400 error when limit exceeded
All validation errors return Response with status 400 and error message
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix VotingDO unbounded growth
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the votes array that grows forever.
acceptanceCriteria: In apps/api/src/dos/voting.ts, remove VoteRecord interface
Change ShowcaseVotes interface to only have total: number
Update vote() method to only increment total, not push to votes array
Remove votes array from storage operations
All existing endpoints still work (vote, getShowcaseVotes, getRemainingVotes, getLeaderboard)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove debug logging from RpcWebSocketDO
userStories.description: As a developer, I want clean production logs without debug noise.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove all console.log calls from apps/api/src/dos/rpc-websocket.ts
Keep console.error calls for actual errors
Typecheck passes
